Name: Capellan Marches
Details: Located rimward of the Capellan Confederation, the Marches were colonized during the Star League, but the losses suffered during the Succession Wars caused House Liao to withdraw from its Periphery settlements and most worlds are now a part of the Aurigan Coalition. Not to be confused with the Capellan March, one of the administrative subdivisions of the Federated Suns.
